ios.desc:
Speech & Audio To Text – The Fastest Way to Read WhatsApp and Telegram Voice Messages

Tired of receiving voice messages when you can’t or don’t want to listen to them? Whether you're in a meeting, on public transport, or just prefer reading over listening, Speech & Audio To Text is the solution you've been waiting for.

This app lets you instantly convert voice messages into text without requiring internet access or cloud services. It works completely offline, ensuring total privacy and no data tracking. No AI. No servers. Just fast, secure, and local transcription right on your device.

Why Use Speech & Audio To Text?
Voice messages are convenient for the sender but not always for the receiver. Long audios can be disruptive, slow to go through, or impossible to play in certain situations. Speech & Audio To Text helps you get the information you need quickly, quietly, and privately.

How It Works
- Tap the voice message in WhatsApp or Telegram
- Share it with Speech to Text
- Get an instant, readable transcript no internet required
- Optionally, translate the transcript into another language
- Share the final result with anyone you want

It’s that simple.

Key Features
- Instant voice-to-text conversion
- Translate transcribed messages into other languages
- Share the final text or translation
- Works 100% offline  no cloud, no AI
- Your data stays on your device
- Supports WhatsApp, Telegram, and Voice Memos
- Multilingual support (device language dependent)
- Minimal, clean design for quick access

Perfect for:
- Meetings or quiet environments  read instead of listening
- Noisy places where voice messages are hard to hear
- Multitasking stay productive without stopping to listen
- Accessibility makes audio content readable for everyone
- Fast communication skip the long playback, scan the text
- Cross-language understanding translate messages instantly

No subscriptions. No ads. No nonsense.
Speech & Audio To Text is a one-time purchase. Once you install it, it's yours forever no hidden costs, no subscriptions, no online dependencies.

Stay in control of your voice messages. Go offline. Stay private.
Try Speech & Audio To Text today.

By the way, AppStore reviews are very helpful to us. If you think Speech & Audio To Text is worthy, would you mind taking a moment to write a nice review? We'd greatly appreciate it. Thanks for using Speech & Audio To Text!

quotes.text:
Hi HN,
I’d like to share a side project I recently finished: Speech & Audio To Text, a small iOS utility to transcribe voice messages from apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Voice Memos — fully offline and without sending any data to the cloud.

The motivation was personal. I often receive voice notes when I can't listen to them — during meetings, while commuting on noisy trains, or when I don’t want to disturb others. I used to rely on an app that handled this well, until it moved to a subscription model and started requiring constant internet access.

I wanted something that would:

- Work offline
- Not send audio to any server
- Be available with a single, one-time purchase
- Support WhatsApp and Telegram voice messages directly
- Handle multiple languages

So I built it. It’s completely local, lightweight, and doesn't use any AI or external APIs. The speech recognition relies on on-device iOS capabilities, and supports over 60 languages depending on system settings.

I'd love to hear your feedback or suggestions. Thanks for checking it out.
